omron.upside: Bittensor subnet with code pushed 14 days ago; any subnet-sector bid could lift it, but no dated catalyst found.
omron.cheap: Website is down and tiny $4.6M cap; likely just unwanted.
omron.wrongIf: Website stays down or daily trading falls under $100K within 30 days.
omron.vsScanner: Scanner's spike is not a catalyst; the dead website worries me more than it does the score.

xmoney-2.upside: Real payments company with fresh code (6 days ago) and Kraken/KuCoin listings; no dated catalyst found for the 20x volume spike.
xmoney-2.cheap: Only 37% of supply released and price is 99% below its peak; market may be pricing future unlocks.
xmoney-2.wrongIf: Volume falls back below $200K/day or a large unlock lands without demand within 30 days.
xmoney-2.vsScanner: Scanner counts the spike as positive; after +41% in a week I treat it as already moved.

elastos.upside: Old Bitcoin-sidechain project listed on Coinbase; I found no news explaining the +130% week.
elastos.wrongIf: Gives back the whole week's gain (below about $0.30) within 2 weeks.
elastos.vsScanner: Scanner shows volume 74x; I could not find the cause, so it is an unexplained spike.

metaplex.upside: Real Solana NFT infrastructure with about $200K/month revenue (June) and buyback dashboard; no dated catalyst for the +104% week.
metaplex.cheap: Revenue is small against supply still to unlock (53% unreleased).
metaplex.wrongIf: Weekly gain fully reverses or revenue stays flat in the next monthly update.
metaplex.vsScanner: Scanner calls it a zombie; I disagree, the product is live, but it already doubled this week.

energy-web-token.upside: Real energy-sector chain with recent activity; no dated catalyst found.
energy-web-token.cheap: No reason found; probably just unwanted.
energy-web-token.wrongIf: Trading stays under $300K/day with no news for 30 days.
energy-web-token.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner that nothing here is a catalyst.

tensor.upside: Real Solana NFT marketplace; no dated catalyst found.
tensor.cheap: NFT sector is out of favour.
tensor.vsScanner: Scanner says zombie; the marketplace is live but I found no catalyst.

holotoken.upside: Holochain is a real long-running project and Binance-listed; the Indodax/ZebPay listing is small and I could not confirm it from official sources.
holotoken.cheap: Token trades at 0.05% of its 2021 high on huge supply.
holotoken.wrongIf: Volume falls back to normal (about $3M/day) within 2 weeks.
holotoken.vsScanner: Scanner's score jump from 4 to 57 is a one-day spike, not a business change.

topPicksNote: Nothing has a dated, verified catalyst; every spike (Elastos +130%, Metaplex +104%, xMoney +41%) has already run and I found no cause.
